findings.title: Historical cwd-drift recommendation has no observation-derived as-of date
findings.what: When the guard is currently configured, all-time command observations are labeled historical and demoted, but the recommendation omits provenance.asOf/provenance.stale and its detail does not say "As of <date>". ToolCall timestamps are available but discarded while session drift is collected, so users cannot reproduce when the historical signal was last observed.
findings.fix: Retain the latest finite timestamp of counted unanchored operations, derive its UTC date, set provenance.asOf and provenance.stale for the demoted branch, and prefix the historical detail with "As of <date>,". If no trustworthy timestamp exists, avoid asserting dated historical freshness.
findings.acceptance: A fixture containing dated unanchored calls plus a configured guard yields severity info, provenance.stale=true, provenance.asOf matching the latest counted call date, and detail beginning exactly "As of <provenance.asOf>,"; the non-demoted branch remains present-tense.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarial re-read confirmed lines 234-243 classify the cumulative signal as historical solely from current guard configuration, while lines 287-305 emit historical wording and provenance without any asOf or stale field. The dispatched discovery-freshness implementation demonstrates that timestamps and observation-derived as-of demotion are feasible, but is comparison-only and is not included in files.

findings.title: Dropped-assignment claims omit structured provenance
findings.what: The recommendation asserts that assignments were dropped, agents never started, and workers never acknowledged work, then returns counts and free-form evidence only. It supplies no provenance observations citing input.teams fields such as droppedCount, droppedAssignments, stalledAgents, or their originating teams artifact, so the claims do not satisfy the detector recommendation audit trail.
findings.fix: Add structured provenance observations for the aggregate dropped count, affected teams, stalled-agent signal, and relevant input.teams fields; classify any interpretation such as "silently" or "never started" as an explicit inference supported by those observations.
findings.acceptance: For both stalled-agent and percentage-only fixtures, provenance validation passes and observations cite the teams source plus exact input.teams fields supporting affected, detail, severity, and evidence; no unsupported causal wording remains.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarial re-read of lines 31-79 confirmed all recommendation facts originate from TeamSummary fields but the returned object has no provenance property. The dispatched test file checks evidence and metadata but contains no provenance assertion; it is comparison-only and is not included in files.

findings.title: Five-row evidence caps are applied after unbounded flatMap allocation
findings.what: The detector uses flatMap across every stalled agent and every dropped assignment, creates every formatted string, and only then slices each result to five. Large team ingests therefore incur memory and formatting work proportional to the full dataset for output that is strictly capped at five rows.
findings.fix: Collect at most five stalled names and five evidence rows with bounded nested loops or a small iterator helper that stops immediately when the cap is reached.
findings.acceptance: A large synthetic TeamSummary input produces the same first five names/evidence rows and aggregate counts while instrumentation confirms no more than five entries per capped output are formatted or retained.
findings.verifyNote: The second pass confirmed slice(0, 5) occurs only after flatMap at lines 52-54 and 61-67; aggregate reductions remain necessary and are not part of this finding.
